descFull: The ultimate open-source Overleaf extension and alternative: a free, self-hosted, drop-in replacement for Overleaf Community Edition with nearly all Pro feature—SSO, AI Assistant, Git(Hub/Lab）/ Dropbox sync, track changes, sandboxed compilation, Zotero, Mendeley and more. Formerly @Ayaka-notes Overleaf Pro. Docs: https://ayakaleaf-pro.ayaka.space
